research_watchouts: The iRace summary line lists the distances as "2K, 5K, 10K, 12K, 42K", an apparent typo; the organiser text on both iRace and Pace8 gives 21 km.
The iRace location field says Tri An, Dong Nai, while the organiser text gives Binh Phuoc ward. Start times and course map not yet published as text.
name: Dong Nai Marathon – Truong Tuoi Group 2026
short_description: Dong Nai Marathon – Truong Tuoi Group is on Sunday 29 November 2026 in Binh Phuoc ward, Dong Nai, over a 2 km kids run, 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Dong Nai Marathon – Truong Tuoi Group 2026, the Dong Nai Newspaper and Radio-Television Cup, is organised by Dong Nai Newspaper and Radio-Television with Truong Tuoi Group as title sponsor. Race day is 29 November 2026 in Binh Phuoc ward, Dong Nai province, with kit collection and the 2 km kids race on 28 November. Distances are 2 km (kids), 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km. iRace lists the race window as 04:00 to 10:30 and the category as road.

core_facts.organizer: Dong Nai Newspaper and Radio-Television (Bao va Phat thanh, Truyen hinh Dong Nai)

faqs.question: What are the cut-offs and age limits at Dong Nai Marathon – Truong Tuoi Group 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pace8 page gives a 6 hour 30 minute cut-off for the 42 km (age 18 and over) and 3 hours 30 minutes for the 21 km (age 16 and over). The 10 km allows 2 hours 30 minutes for ages 12 and over, and the 5 km allows 1 hour 30 minutes for ages 10 and over. The kids 2 km is for ages 5 to 14 with a 45 minute cut-off.

faqs.question: When is kit collection for Dong Nai Marathon – Truong Tuoi Group 2026?
faqs.answer: Race kits are handed out on 28 November 2026, the day the kids 2 km is also run. All other distances race on 29 November 2026 in Binh Phuoc ward. Both Vietnamese citizens and foreigners who meet the age and health rules may enter.
